### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | stableexpression output directory (reporting/, merged_data/, datasets/, statistics/, errors/, warnings/, id_mapping/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Sample design table: batch (the dataset), condition and sample, plus any annotation column. Defaults to the pipeline's merged_data/whole_design.csv. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design id column. stableexpression fixes it to sample; recorded for the metadata auto-detection. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Sample hub column the dashboard groups and filters samples by. Defaults to platform (Microarray or RNA-seq), derived from the dataset directories; name an annotation column of METADATA_FILE instead. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |
| `TOP_PER_SECTION` | — | Candidates per expression section summarised as box statistics (stableexpression_stable_gene_distribution). Default 25, as many as the pipeline's report draws. |
| `VALUES_PER_SECTION` | — | Candidates per expression section kept as one row per sample (stableexpression_stable_gene_values), the boxes the sample filters can redraw. Default 2; each gene adds a row per sample. |
| `NO_ID_MAPPING` | — | Set (--var NO_ID_MAPPING=true) for a run with --skip_id_mapping: no ID mapping statistics are written, so the ID mapping collection and tab are removed. |

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (8 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/stableexpression/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/stableexpression/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub for nf-core/stableexpression: one row per public sample of the run. | `sample`, `dataset`, `accession`, `array_design`, `platform`, `normalisation`, `condition`, `status`, `missing_share` |
| [`stableexpression/dataset_funnel.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/dataset_funnel.py) | The samples of every nf-core/stableexpression dataset, step by step (long form). | `step_key`, `dataset`, `platform`, `outcome`, `step`, `step_order`, `samples`, `samples_lost`, `dataset_in` |
| [`stableexpression/dataset_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/dataset_summary.py) | One row per dataset nf-core/stableexpression downloaded, and what became of it. | `dataset`, `accession`, `platform`, `normalisation`, `array_design`, `design`, `outcome`, `conditions`, `samples_downloaded`, `samples_id_mapped`, `samples_after_zero_filter`, `samples_kept`, `samples_rejected_zeros`, `samples_rejected_missing`, `kept_share`, `gene_ids_in`, `genes_kept`, `ids_collapsed`, `genes_rare`, `ids_unmapped`, `mapped_share`, `zero_share`, `missing_share`, `skewness`, `downloaded`, `id_mapped`, `merged`, `failure_reason`, `mapping_note` |
| [`stableexpression/gene_stability.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/gene_stability.py) | Stability score of every candidate gene of nf-core/stableexpression. | `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `gene_symbol`, `description`, `section`, `section_index`, `section_rank`, `overall_rank`, `rank_weight`, `stability_score`, `normfinder_stability`, `genorm_m`, `normfinder_rank`, `genorm_rank`, `cv`, `robust_cv`, `normfinder_norm`, `genorm_norm`, `cv_norm`, `robust_cv_norm`, `missing_penalty`, `normfinder_part`, `genorm_part`, `cv_part`, `robust_cv_part`, `mean`, `median`, `measured_share`, `zero_share`, `expression_percentile`, `expression_level`, `platforms`, `source_ids` |
| [`stableexpression/gene_statistics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/gene_statistics.py) | Expression statistics of every gene of nf-core/stableexpression's merged matrix. | `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `gene_symbol`, `description`, `section`, `section_index`, `expression_percentile`, `expression_level`, `candidate`, `mean`, `median`, `standard_deviation`, `mad`, `cv`, `robust_cv`, `measured_share`, `zero_share`, `platforms`, `source_ids` |
| [`stableexpression/id_mapping.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/id_mapping.py) | Where the gene ids of every nf-core/stableexpression dataset went (long form). | `fate_key`, `dataset`, `accession`, `platform`, `outcome`, `fate`, `fate_order`, `gene_ids`, `share` |
| [`stableexpression/score_components.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/score_components.py) | The stability score of every candidate gene, split into its parts (long form). | `part_key`, `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `section`, `section_index`, `section_rank`, `overall_rank`, `stability_score`, `component`, `component_order`, `contribution`, `normalised_value` |
| [`stableexpression/stable_gene_distribution.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/stable_gene_distribution.py) | Box statistics of the most stable genes of every section of nf-core/stableexpression. | `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `section`, `section_index`, `section_rank`, `overall_rank`, `stability_score`, `q1`, `median`, `q3`, `lower`, `upper`, `mean`, `sd`, `min`, `max`, `n_measured`, `n_samples`, `measured_share`, `expression_level` |
| [`stableexpression/stable_gene_values.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/stableexpression/stable_gene_values.py) | Normalised expression of the very top candidates of each section, sample by sample. | `value_key`, `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `section`, `section_index`, `section_rank`, `overall_rank`, `stability_score`, `sample`, `dataset`, `value` |
